review.method: Local Whisper large-v3-turbo and large-v3 whole-track recognition, three targeted verse checks, and independent meaning review of all 74 corresponding transcription rows. A fourth short crop produced only an excluded hallucination.
review.timing: Draft phrase timings from Whisper segment and word timestamps. Needs user audiovisual review.

uncertainties.issue: Idaku versus daku: the recognized written word permits either pronunciation.
One targeted pass adds ai wo before nakushita; both whole-track passes omit it. Omitted provisionally; check the beginning of this phrase.
Jikuu is the ordinary reading of the recognized word; a special sung reading such as toki remains possible.

notes: Unsupported credits, social-media names and thanks-for-watching hallucinations are excluded.
Targeted recognition corroborates boku de, kujikenu, the smile/listening verse, and repeated haha naru hoshi.
First person follows boku; you follows kimi. No gender is inferred. Calling my name is a contextual inference from the surrounding recollection.
Tatae describes holding or brimming with water, not praise. Hazu expresses expectation, not certainty.
Wordless vocalizations are not transcribed as invented lyrics. Gaps are labeled Music.
MP3 lyric preview only; not synchronized to game credits and not patched into the game.

subtitles.romaji: Aoi daichi ni kiyoki mizu tatae
subtitles.text: With pure waters filling the blue earth,

subtitles.romaji: Idaku inochi no haha naru hoshi ni negau
subtitles.text: I pray to the mother planet that cradles life.

subtitles.romaji: Dore hodo no kanashimi ni mo
subtitles.text: No matter how deep the sorrow,
May I never lose heart.
Even then, may I keep on loving,
May I never stop.
Small and ordinary as I am,

subtitles.romaji: Dareka no tame ni nani ga dekiru no darou
subtitles.text: What could I do for someone else?

subtitles.romaji: Nakushita kinou no yume ni obieru yori mo
subtitles.text: Rather than fear yesterday's lost dreams,
subtitles.uncertainty_note: Check phrase opening: is ai wo sung before nakushita?

subtitles.romaji: Hoshi furu kyou no yozora ni
subtitles.text: To tonight's sky of falling stars,
I sing of love.

subtitles.romaji: Ai yue ni hito wa daremo
subtitles.text: If love brings everyone
pain to bear,

subtitles.romaji: Ai yue ni hito wa itsuka
subtitles.text: Then through love, someday
We should be able to forgive each other.
When I close my eyes, that smile comes to mind.
When I listen closely,
I hear a voice calling my name.

subtitles.romaji: Donna ni tooku ni ite mo
subtitles.text: No matter how far apart we are,
When I think of you,
Across the vast reaches of time and space,
subtitles.uncertainty_note: Check pronunciation: jikuu, or a special reading such as toki?

subtitles.text: We can meet again.
Upon the blue earth,
Brimming with pure water,
Cradling life—
I pray to our mother planet.
